content:
“Channel your inner Grognak!”

**Barbarian** is a Strength-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Provides Damage Resistance based on current Strength. Bonus is doubled when not wearing any armor, power armor or body suits.

| ![FO76 barbarian perk bonus](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/fallout/images/9/99/FO76_barbarian_perk_bonus.png) | | 
| | Strength | Damage Resistance | 
| | 1 | +18 | 
| | 15 | +61 | 
| | 30 | +96 | 
| | 60 | +131 | 
| | 100 | +175 | 

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | Gain Damage Resistance based on your STR. Doubled when not wearing armor. | 00242E59 | 

- Before Update 58 Barbarian had three ranks and provided +2/+3/+4 damage resistance per Strength point up to 20x.

Other perks that scale with Strength include:

- Strong Back - more carry capacity

Barbarian is not the only Damage Resistance perk in the game and stacks with similar perks, including:

- Bodyguards (Charisma perk)- Scales based on Charisma and number of teammates
- Ironclad (Endurance perk): Up to 25% more protection. Double if wearing a matching set - Damage & Energy Resistance
- Iron Stomach (Endurance perk) - Scales based on Endurance
- Junk Shield (Luck perk): Scales based on junk + Luck - Damage & Energy Resistance
- Lone Wanderer (Charisma perk) Scales based on Charisma - Damage & Energy Resistance
- Refractor (Perception perk): Scales based on Perception - Energy Resistance
